reviews.t: Great for windburned and cold damaged skin
reviews.x: I'm a mail carrier and have been working in 30 mph winds and sub zero temperatures for the last couple weeks. This oil does an amazing job of helping my hands and face recover from the damage of working 10 hours a day in really bad condition's. I have tried several other products some of which are very good but this is the best I've used. It does leave your skin oily for 10 or so minutes after you apply it but after that it is completely absorbed unlike petroleum jelly based products.

I live in a sunny, warm climate, so I am frequently outdoors where my skin gets dry from  the elements. I use this as a moisturizer for my hair and face after showering, and I love the way my skin just seems to drink it up. There is no greasiness or oil film and my skin and hair seem to actually "thank" me for the wonderful way they feel after application. This is GREAT stuff !

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the oil for softening and conditioning beards, hair, and skin, with many calling it lightweight and non-greasy.
Several reviewers say a little goes a long way and that it absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy or slick feeling.
Some reviewers find the product too expensive or not worth the price.
A few reviewers report it did not help with dry patches or did not live up to expectations.
Multiple reviewers mention using it successfully on sensitive skin, including as a pre-shave oil to prevent irritation.
